# LTX 2

> > LTX 2 is an AI video generation platform featuring 4K output, audio synchronization, and ComfyUI integration for professional video creators.

Developed by Lightricks, LTX 2 offers both text-to-video and image-to-video generation capabilities with NVIDIA optimization. The platform is set to release as an open-source foundation model in 2026, supporting LoRA fine-tuning and advanced multimodal AI workflows.

## Key Topics

- LTX 2 AI Video Generator
- ComfyUI workflow integration
- Text-to-video generation
- Image-to-video conversion
- 4K video output
- Audio-video synchronization
- Open-source AI models

## Core Features

- [LTX 2 AI Video Generator Online - 4K, Audio Sync & Pro Workflow Tool](https://ltx-2.org): Homepage for LTX 2 AI video generator with 4K, audio sync & ComfyUI support
- [Image to Video](https://ltx-2.org/image-to-video): Image-to-video AI generator feature page for creating animated videos
